newsitem.title: CANADA: Manitoba hog cash, forward prices unquoted July 4.
newsitem.headline: Manitoba hog cash, forward prices unquoted July 4.

text.p: Manitoba hog cash and forward contract prices will not be issued on Friday, marketers said.
Manitoba Agriculture's daily cash hog prices will not be issued for this and the six subsequent Fridays because the provincial government closes all its offices to reduce its operating costs.

Manitoba Pork, which markets about 85 percent of Manitoba hog output, will not issue afternoon forward contract prices as its benchmark, the Chicago Mercantile Exchange's hog futures, are not trading to mark U.S. Independence Day.
